requirements.general_text: Any of These: A-Level / STPM: BBB including B in Mathematics UEC: 12 points or less including an A in Mathematics (5 subjects not less than a B grade) ATAR (WACE/SACE): ATAR 80 including B in Mathematics Method/Specialist Canada Year 12 High School Diploma: 80% including B in Mathematics International Baccalaureate Diploma: 26 points with 5 in HL Mathematics AA or AI Matriculation / Foundation: CGPA 3.0 (further assessment is required) Diploma: CGPA 3.0 including B in Mathematics (further assessment is required). Global College: Foundation in Business / Foundation in Science (from Heriot-Watt University Malaysia): Grade C average including B in Mathematics and C in English SMA 3 (Indonesia): 8.0 including 80% in Mathematics Year 12 State Board High School Examination (India): 70% including 70% in Mathematics Senior High School Graduation Certificate (China): 80% including 80% in Mathematics Important Notes: Applications from individuals with a wide range of qualifications are encouraged. Eligibility is best determined by submitting a complete application with academic documents. Entry requirements are subject to change, and individual offers may vary. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 5.5. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.0 requirement.
